card.name: Study nouns opening a news sentence
card.fires_on: Nouns like findings, study, results, research or announcement right after "The" or "These" at the start of a sentence in a news report. They refer back to a study just described.

modes.label: Findings as subject
modes.description: The word findings, finding or results begins a sentence about the study just mentioned.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward a verb such as follows or follow, and away from data-type nouns.
card.plain: It fires on a sentence-opening phrase like "The findings" that points back to the study just described.
